comments.author: Kosh_Ascadian
comments.body:
Personally I do not understand the combination "cozy game" and super anxiety inducing UI and balance this stick in the air gameplay.

To be fair, you're not the only one doing this stuff. But I just do not understand what is cozy about being on edge every moment of gameplay.

replies.author: NoSociety2178
replies.body: ![gif](giphy|wvawU2tHPrdyXpClBz)

replies.author: NoSociety2178
replies.body: I don’t intend it to be anxiety inducing, this was legit 5 prompts I just started today. I’m just showing a general concept, there’s no death or combat. Surfing, boarding, gliding across water and earth. Bond with dragons to fly. The music atmospheric sounds will make it a chill time.

replies.author: Kosh_Ascadian
replies.body: Chill music with anxious gameplay does not make the game chill. If you want to make a cozy game cozy then think of a chill and cozy design. Low stress, low anxiety etc.
